en: Good morning, everyone.
zh: 大家早上好。

en: Happy Sunday. I just made myself a smoothie for breakfast.
zh: 周日快乐。我刚给自己做了一杯早餐奶昔。

en: This has pineapple, mango, and strawberries.
zh: 里面有菠萝、芒果和草莓。

en: Very good. And it is already, in fact, 11:30.
zh: 很好喝。而且现在其实已经11点半了。

en: I've had a very chill Sunday morning.
zh: 我度过了一个非常悠闲的周日早晨。

en: I slept in, which was really nice.
zh: 我睡了个懒觉，感觉真的很舒服。

en: and took some time journaling in bed.
zh: 还躺在床上写了一会儿日记。

en: but it is about time I get my day started I actually wrote out.
zh: 不过也差不多该开始这一天了，我其实还写了。

en: a little to-do list to keep myself on track.
zh: 一份小小的待办清单，好让自己别跑偏。

en: For the most part today, I really just have to catch up on editing.
zh: 今天大部分时间，我其实就是得补一下剪辑进度。

en: That's my main task that I feel like I'm constantly having to stay on track with,
zh: 这是我最主要的任务，而且我感觉自己总是得提醒自己跟上进度。

en: but I have a bunch of short-form videos that I have just sitting on my hard drive,
zh: 不过我硬盘里还堆着一堆短视频。

en: so I'd love to go through all of them, ideally.
zh: 所以我理想情况下很想把它们都过一遍。

en: and edit every single video.
zh: 然后把每一条视频都剪完。

en: It's not necessarily that time-consuming.
zh: 这倒不一定有多耗时间。

en: It's just that I have to sit down and get it all done.
zh: 只是我必须坐下来，把它们一次性做完。

en: I also didn't film yesterday, which was Saturday.
zh: 我昨天也没有拍视频，昨天是周六。

en: because I had a very mundane day.
zh: 因为我过得非常平淡。

en: I just pretty much spent the entire day cleaning up the house.
zh: 我基本上一整天都在收拾家里。

en: It's really been a resetting kind of weekend.
zh: 这个周末真的有点像是在重新整理状态。

en: I took all day yesterday to clean, and now I'm catching up on work today.
zh: 我昨天花了一整天打扫，今天就开始补工作进度。

en: to get myself on track for the week.
zh: 好让自己为新的一周进入正轨。

en: I did want to give you guys a bit of a haul,
zh: 我确实想给你们简单分享一下我买了什么。

en: because I did end up getting some things from Brandy Melville when I went on Friday.
zh: 因为我周五去的时候，最后还是在Brandy Melville买了些东西。

en: I feel like it's always hit or miss in there.
zh: 我感觉那家店真的总是看运气。

en: They always are changing out the things that are on display.
zh: 他们展示出来的东西一直在换。

en: so it's kind of just a matter of luck.
zh: 所以有点就是看运气。

en: and seeing what they have in store when I go in.
zh: 看我进去的时候店里刚好有什么。

en: And I feel like they always have a lot of really good.
zh: 而且我觉得他们总是有很多非常不错的。

en: staple basics that I find myself always reaching for in my closet.
zh: 基础款单品，是我衣橱里总会反复拿来穿的那种。

en: So all this to say, I thought I would go in and see what they have.
zh: 所以说了这么多，我就想着进去看看他们有什么。

en: I'm specifically also kind of on the hunt for.
zh: 我其实也在特别留意。

en: some pieces for spring and summer that I can add into my wardrobe,
zh: 一些可以加进我衣橱里的春夏单品。

en: because I feel like in terms of winter clothing, I love to wear sweaters,
zh: 因为我觉得冬装这方面，我很喜欢穿毛衣。

en: so I have a bunch of those.
zh: 所以我有一大堆毛衣。

en: But then as soon as it gets warm out.
zh: 但天气一变暖。

en: I don't really have that many clothes to wear.
zh: 我就真的没那么多衣服可以穿。

en: And I feel like it's hard for me to dress cute in the summertime,
zh: 而且我觉得夏天对我来说很难穿得好看。

en: because the only thing I'm thinking about is.
zh: 因为我脑子里唯一在想的就是。

en: being comfortable and not being super sweaty.
zh: 要舒服，而且不要热得满身是汗。

en: So anyways, I got a few things for spring and summer, and I think eventually down the line,
zh: 总之，我买了几件春夏穿的东西，而且我觉得以后某个时候。

en: I'm gonna do like a big spring cleaning and kind of clean out my closet,
zh: 我会来一次大规模的春季清理，顺便整理一下衣橱。

en: swap out my winter clothes for my summer clothing.
zh: 把冬装换成夏装。

en: And that way I can really see what it is that I have.
zh: 这样我就能真正看清自己到底有什么。

en: and maybe even go thrifting for some summer clothes.
zh: 也许还会去淘一些夏天的衣服。

en: We will see.
zh: 到时候再看吧。

en: First things first, I just got this very basic white tank top,
zh: 首先，我买了这件非常基础的白色背心。

en: but it has these kind of thicker straps, which I liked.
zh: 不过它的肩带是这种稍微宽一点的，我挺喜欢的。

en: I know this is nothing very groundbreaking in terms of fashion.
zh: 我知道从时尚角度来说，这不是什么特别颠覆性的东西。

en: but I truly feel like these are the kind of basics I end up wearing the most on a day-to-day basis.
zh: 但我真心觉得，这种基础款才是我日常最常穿的衣服。

en: And then also when I tried it on, obviously.
zh: 然后我试穿的时候，当然。

en: this is like the way it's supposed to face with like the lower neck kind of in the front.
zh: 它本来应该是这样穿的，也就是低一点的领口在前面。

en: But I also tried it on backwards.
zh: 但我也反过来试穿了一下。

en: just to see, and it does have like the logo on the back,
zh: 就是想看看效果，而且它背后确实有个logo。

en: but it doesn't really peek through when I wear it backwards.
zh: 但我反着穿的时候，基本也不会透出来。

en: So I could also wear it facing the other side with kind of a higher neckline.
zh: 所以我也可以把它反过来穿，变成领口更高一点的样子。

en: I don't know.
zh: 我也不知道。

en: This is just me trying to get the most versatility out of what I have,
zh: 这只是我想尽量把手头的衣服穿出更多搭配方式。

en: but basic white tank top, I feel like you can't go wrong with that.
zh: 但基础白背心嘛，我觉得怎么都不会出错。

en: And then I also got a basic kind of white T.
zh: 然后我还买了一件基础款的白色T恤。

en: This is more of like a heather gray.
zh: 它更像是这种麻灰色。

en: It's a little bit darker.
zh: 颜色稍微深一点。

en: and the neckline is kind of not necessarily off the shoulders.
zh: 领口不一定算是露肩。

en: but like more of a scoop neckline which I liked.
zh: 但更像是一个大圆领，我挺喜欢的。

en: And then last but not least, I'm very excited about this one
zh: 最后但同样重要的是，这件我特别期待。

en: because I think it is very up my alley.
zh: 因为我觉得它非常符合我的风格。

en: It is this white long sleeve and it's actually more of a quarter sleeves.
zh: 这是一件白色长袖，但其实更像是七分袖。

en: And then the neckline had this kind of detailing that I thought was really cute.
zh: 然后领口有这种小细节，我觉得特别可爱。

en: I figured I can very easily like dress this up or down depending on the occasion.
zh: 我感觉根据不同场合，我可以很轻松地把它穿得正式一点或者休闲一点。

en: And I really need to like buy more colorful clothing.
zh: 而且我真的需要多买一些有颜色的衣服。

en: because I realized most of the clothes I wear on a daily basis are.
zh: 因为我发现我日常穿的大多数衣服都是。

en: black or white or some shade of gray.
zh: 黑色、白色，或者某种灰色。

en: And I really want to incorporate more color.
zh: 我真的很想加入更多颜色。

en: I think it's super cute.
zh: 我觉得有颜色的衣服超级可爱。

en: I just can never pull the trigger because.
zh: 我只是一直下不了决心买。

en: I feel like I don't really know what colors suit me that much.
zh: 因为我感觉自己真的不太知道什么颜色适合我。

en: Occasionally, if I'm feeling kind of wild, I might wear some navy,
zh: 偶尔如果我觉得自己有点大胆，我可能会穿点海军蓝。

en: but I feel like I don't really take many risks.
zh: 但我觉得自己真的不太敢冒险。

en: when it comes to different colors and patterns.
zh: 尤其是在不同颜色和图案这方面。

en: But then I feel like whenever I wear something a little bit more colorful.
zh: 但我又觉得每次我穿得稍微更有颜色一点。

en: or a bit more out there, then I get more compliments.
zh: 或者稍微更出挑一点的时候，我就会收到更多夸奖。

en: So maybe that's a sign that I should take more risks because.
zh: 所以也许这就是一个信号，说明我应该多尝试一点。

en: unfortunately I love my basic staples.
zh: 可惜的是，我真的太爱我的基础款了。

en: That is my little haul from Brandy.
zh: 这就是我在Brandy买的小小战利品。

en: I am actually gonna finish getting ready.
zh: 我现在其实要继续把自己收拾好。

en: I'm still in my PJs right now, so I'm gonna change probably into some comfy sweats.
zh: 我现在还穿着睡衣，所以我大概会换上一身舒服的运动休闲裤。

en: I'm just staying home today, so I love to be comfortable.
zh: 我今天就待在家里，所以我很喜欢穿得舒服一点。

en: I was thinking I might actually curl my hair.
zh: 我刚刚在想，也许我其实可以卷一下头发。

en: Even though I'm not leaving the house.
zh: 虽然我不会出门。

en: I just washed it yesterday, so it might be nice to style it and then.
zh: 我昨天刚洗过头，所以稍微做个造型应该也不错。

en: that way it can be curled for the week ahead as well.
zh: 这样接下来这一周头发也可以保持卷卷的状态。

en: I'm gonna do that and then.
zh: 我准备去做一下这个，然后。

en: we can get to work on my to-do list for the day.
zh: 我们就可以开始处理我今天的待办清单了。
